01 / New project · Industrial computer vision

AnomaVision

Teach a system what normal looks like. Then find what doesn’t belong. Industrial anomaly detection with dense DINOv3 features, compact reference memory banks, defect heatmaps and visual similarity retrieval.

1.0000Image AUROC · MVTec AD bottle
0.9995Image AUROC · MVTec AD metal_nut

Repository-reported results on two benchmark categories, with thresholds calibrated on held-out normal images. Not a claim of factory deployment.

DINOv3PatchCoreFAISSSAM 3Modal GPUFastAPI
REAL INSPECTION OUTPUTS / CLICK TO ENLARGE
01 / Learn normality

Frozen DINOv3 patch features and a greedy k-center coreset model normal components without training on defect examples.

02 / Localize the exception

Nearest-neighbor patch scoring reveals local defects. Optional SAM 3 gating suppresses background responses.

03 / Make it inspectable

Reference retrieval, drift monitoring and reproducible evaluation connect the model to an inspection workflow.

02 / REINFORCEMENT LEARNING

PushLab

Robots that learn to take a push.

A reinforcement learning platform for robust quadruped locomotion. I built the PPO training loop, GPU-parallel MuJoCo MJX environments and an interactive 3D robotics lab to study recovery under external forces.

Nominal and disturbance-trained policies face the same evaluation regimes, including unseen directions and stronger pushes.

JAX / PPOMuJoCo MJX512 environmentsThree.js

100% vs. 41.7% survival under 52–64 N pushes, robust vs. baseline PPO, across 12 simulation seeds. Simulation results; no hardware transfer claimed.

Explore repository ↗Mathematics ↗
03 / MULTIMODAL RETRIEVAL

OmniSeek

Five modalities. One search.

A semantic search engine for text, images, audio, video and code. I connected native multimodal embeddings to a local API, vector search and a React interface that keeps source files, line numbers and timestamps attached to each result.

An Embedding Lab makes the index visible. Existing indexes remain searchable on CPU after the cloud GPU stops.

EmbeddingGemma 2ModalFAISSFastAPIReact

Actual application screenshots with indexed demo assets. Cached demo queries run locally; new query embeddings require model inference.

Explore repository ↗API validation ↗
04 / GPU ENGINEERING

Helix

Below the model. Close to the hardware.

Original CUDA C++ and Triton kernels for transformer inference: softmax, RMSNorm, GEMM, tiled attention and INT8 weight-only linear operations.

I connect numerical correctness, memory access and execution mapping to measured performance against native PyTorch baselines.

CUDA C++TritonPyTorchNVIDIA L4

176 correctness tests · 171 benchmark comparisons. The initial L4 report includes wins and slower kernels. The chart shows specific FP16 CUDA Graph measurements, not universal speedups.

Explore repository ↗Benchmark report ↗
05 / ML LIFECYCLE & MLOPS

Sentinel

A model is only part of the system.

A fraud-detection ML platform with chronological evaluation, versioned artifacts, model promotion policies, drift checks and real HTTP inference.

I built the local lifecycle and recovery workflow, plus Terraform definitions for a cost-conscious AWS deployment.

scikit-learnFastAPIDVC / MLflowAWS / Terraform

0.7566 held-out PR-AUC on the public fraud benchmark. Local execution is verified; AWS deployment remains defined, not operationally verified. The baseline achieved lower held-out test cost.

04 / How I work

Strong foundations.
Inspectable systems.

I’m Luis Gonzalez, an AI/ML Engineer with a strong mathematical foundation and seven years of experience building solutions across industries. I’m also pursuing a master’s degree in artificial intelligence.

I’m interested in what happens between an idea and a system someone can use: the objective, the implementation, the failure cases and the evidence.

∇Start with the question

Connect the mathematical objective to the actual problem and establish a useful baseline.

≈Measure the tradeoffs

Check correctness, quality, latency and cost under explicit experimental conditions.

↗Build for inspection

Keep the experiments reproducible, the sources traceable and the limitations visible.

Let’s build something useful

A good question deserves
a well-engineered answer.
